points.description: Intermittent stream: has flowing water only during certain times of the year, when groundwater provides water for streamflow (groundwater is the main source); may have no flowing water during dry periods.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only 'flows during certain times of the year / not in dry periods' is stated without groundwater as the source.

points.description: Ephemeral stream: has flowing water only during and for a short duration after precipitation events in a typical year; the streambed is above the water table year-round and groundwater is not a source of water for the stream.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only 'flows during/after precipitation only' is stated without stating that groundwater is not a source (streambed above the water table).

rubric.notes: Harsh: each point needs both the flow timing and the water source (groundwater for intermittent; precipitation only, no groundwater for ephemeral) stated precisely. Giving only the flow timing earns half of that point; vague wording like 'flows sometimes' earns nothing. A wrong statement, such as swapping the two stream types or saying ephemeral streams get groundwater, earns nothing for that point.
